## 中文原文

你下午和朋友发消息，约好晚上一起去家附近的火锅店吃饭。你提前几分钟到了餐厅门口等他，朋友到了之后你们一起进去，找了个靠窗的位置坐下，点了肥牛、毛肚和一些蔬菜，边吃边聊最近的工作和生活，吃得很开心，最后一起结账离开。

## English translation

I texted my friend this afternoon to arrange dinner at a hotpot restaurant near my place.

I got there a few minutes early and waited for him outside.

When he arrived, we went in and sat down at a table by the window.

We ordered fatty beef, beef tripe and a few vegetables, and chatted away about our recent work and lives over the meal.

We had such a nice time, and after we split the bill, we headed out together.
